_comment: Keywords are matched as whole words/phrases against the post title (case-insensitive, Bangla included) -- 'programmer' won't match inside another word, and 'it officer' won't match inside 'audit officer'. This list is intentionally narrow: genuine programming/CSE roles only. It deliberately EXCLUDES 'computer operator', 'data entry operator', 'steno-typist', etc. -- those are clerical/typing posts that happen to mention 'computer' but aren't programming jobs. Add more terms here if you want to broaden it (e.g. 'network engineer', 'system analyst').
